craft_notes: Sthāyin: quiet keeps sequence. Rows: pour then hush-question. Rejected: answering — killed: question kept open. Read aloud: hush held.

lines: Here breath pours the world, that long the night;
where breath hushes — in breath and in Brahma's cave-abode, in the hush — what knowing? — sequence there too.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atra prāṇo jagat sṛjati tāvatī rātriḥ yatra prāṇapraśamaḥ prāṇe ca brahmabiladhāmni śānte 'pi yā saṃvit tatrāpy asti kramaḥ
